`interface IConsumableEvent`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`NodeInputEvent`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/), [`UIInputEvent`](/reference/events/uiinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IConsumableEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/IConsumableEvent.java)

An input event that a listener consumes to stop it.

## Description

The `handleX` events implement it.
A consumed input reaches no other listener except the `MONITOR` ones, none of the handling of a node, no UI below and not the host application.
